name: Exp_ColorMETRO
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the ColorMETRO custom indicator, which uses RSI with fast and slow step sizes to generate momentum signals. It opens buy positions when the RSI fast line crosses above the slow line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable permissions for entry and exit. Position sizing uses a money management parameter that can operate as either a deposit percentage or fixed lot size.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorMETRO自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标使用RSI配合快慢步长来生成动量信号。当RSI快线上穿慢线时开多仓，反之开空仓，并可配置入场和出场的权限。仓位管理使用资金管理参数，可作为存款比例或固定手数运作。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorMETRO指标的动量交叉，该指标内部使用RSI周期为7，配合快步长5和慢步长15来识别趋势方向的变化。入场条件：当MPlus线上穿MMinus线时产生买入信号（前一周期MPlus>MMinus且前两周期MPlus<=MMinus），反之下穿产生卖出信号。出场条件：买入信号同时触发空头平仓，卖出信号同时触发多头平仓，另外设置了固定点数的止损1000点和止盈2000点。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示存款比例。资金管理方面没有加仓、减仓或追踪止损机制，仅依赖固定止损止盈和信号反转平仓。策略使用H4周期和SignalBar=1（前一根K线）来避免噪音，属于中长线动量跟踪系统。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum crossover from the ColorMETRO indicator, which internally uses an RSI period of 7 combined with a fast step of 5 and a slow step of 15 to identify changes in trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the MPlus line crosses above the MMinus line (MPlus[1]>MMinus[1] and MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0]), and a sell signal on the opposite crossover. Exit conditions: a buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of short positions, and a sell signal triggers closing of long positions, with additional fixed stop loss at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management lacks scaling, pyramiding, or trailing stop mechanisms, relying solely on fixed SL/TP and signal-reversal exits. The strategy uses the H4 timeframe and SignalBar=1 (previous bar) to reduce noise, functioning as a medium-to-long-term momentum following system.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用H4等较大周期配合SignalBar=1，有效过滤市场噪音减少虚假信号
提供买入和卖出的开仓/平仓独立开关，灵活控制交易方向
MM参数设计灵活，既支持固定手数也支持按存款比例计算仓位
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复开仓
包含滑点控制和历史数据加载机制，提升交易执行可靠性
pros_en: Uses larger timeframes like H4 with SignalBar=1 to effectively filter market noise and reduce false signals
Provides independent toggle switches for buy/sell entry and exit, offering flexible directional control
The MM parameter design is flexible, supporting both fixed lot sizes and deposit-percentage-based position sizing
Implements new bar detection to prevent repeated entries within the same bar
Includes slippage control and history data loading mechanisms for improved trade execution reliability
cons: 完全依赖自定义ColorMETRO指标，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动性（ATR）动态调整
缺少追踪止损机制，在趋势行情中可能无法锁定足够利润
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
未考虑点差和交易成本对短线信号的影响
OnInit返回0而非INIT_SUCCEEDED，不符合MQL5最佳实践
cons_en: Completely depends on the custom ColorMETRO indicator; if the indicator file is missing the EA cannot run
Fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility (ATR)
Lacks a trailing stop mechanism, potentially failing to lock in sufficient profits during trending markets
No position check logic exists, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Does not account for spread and trading costs' impact on signal profitability
OnInit returns 0 instead of INIT_SUCCEEDED, which does not follow MQL5 best practices
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，根据市场波动性自适应调整风险参数
添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，并考虑加入追踪止损功能
增加点差过滤条件，在点差过大时暂停交易以保护资金安全
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit calculation to adaptively adjust risk parameters based on market volatility
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction, and consider implementing a trailing stop feature
Add a spread filter condition to pause trading when the spread is excessively wide, protecting capital

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查，可能在同方向已有仓位时重复开仓导致过度杠杆
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化，在低波动期止损可能过大，高波动期止盈可能过小
依赖外部自定义指标文件，若指标加载失败仅有打印警告而未阻止EA继续运行
risk_points_en: Lacks position checking, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction leading to overleveraging
Fixed SL/TP does not account for market volatility changes; SL may be too large in low-volatility periods and TP too small in high-volatility periods
Depends on an external custom indicator file; if loading fails only a warning is printed without preventing the EA from continuing to run
